title: DeepSeek Harness
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on your own dsh over ACP with Tomrade's tools, found inside the DeepSeek Harness desktop app when it is not on PATH, a ticket can also go to dsh in a terminal, and its DeepSeek account or key answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: A background call writes a one-run dsh plugin, its patch and its session into a temporary folder that is removed afterwards, and runs in an empty temporary folder of its own.
why.exec: Runs your own `dsh` command, or the one inside the DeepSeek Harness app: `dsh --profile acp` for conversations and `dsh --profile headless` for background calls.
